arStrings.szText: Haven’t had a roof over my head in months. So she offers up Donan’s old place. Weren't no one using it anyway, she says.
Only when we get there, the keep is thick with demons spittin’ fire. Half our group’s dead, the other half's mad with shock!
Vasily’s stones. I said the manor, not the keep. The keep stays empty.
I’ll find out what drew the demons there. And then I’ll put them down. That weapon just for show, or do you know how to swing it, too? Could use your help at Eldhaime.
